create_weights_moe_layer: create weights for a MoE layer with full-precision meta device tensors and optional biases
process_weights_after_loading: process and quantize MoE weights after loading via the QeRL layerwise processing system
inject_biases_quant_config: inject biases into the MoE quant config for models with biased MoE layers
apply_monolithic_moe: apply monolithic fused MoE kernel with expert routing and scaling parameters
apply_moe_layer: apply non-monolithic fused MoE kernel with top-k expert selection and shared experts
